text:
Mira: Hey folks :wave: starting my on-call rotation tomorrow. Quick check — I think I don’t have pager access and I can’t open the runbooks. Who should I ping for access? Also would love to shadow someone this week if possible.

Alex: Hey Mira — welcome! :thumbsup: You should have been invited to PagerDuty; check your email spam. I can add you to the shadow schedule. What time windows work for you?

Mira: Morning PST works best. Also I clicked the runbook link in the onboarding checklist and got a 403. Is there an IAM role I need?

OpsBot: Pager duty assignment created for Mira. Shadow request queued to Alex. See: https://redwood.internal/tools/pagerduty

Sam: Mira — I ran into the same 403. Request the oncall-read role in internal IAM (self-service). If that fails, ping eng-security. Alex, can you temporarily grant runbook-view to Mira?

Alex: Done — granted runbook-view for Mira. Give it a minute and try again.

Mira: Okay I can open the runbook now, thanks! Quick policy question — for GPU infra perf regressions do we page Platform SRE directly, or open the dedicated-capacity queue first? Trying to know what to do if I get a latency alert overnight.

Jun: For infra perf: if latency P95 > 200ms for more than 5 minutes, page platform-sre escalation immediately. If it’s noisy spikes or batch-y stuff, open a ticket to the dedicated-capacity queue and annotate the alert. Runbook -> Escalation -> severe-infra section has the exact thresholds.

Sam: Also FYI for the shadowing sim — bring a laptop with access to prod-staging and run the local sim scripts. Example commands we use in training: 

```
# simulate high qps against inference service
scripts/simulate_load.sh --target inference --qps 120 --duration 10m
# sanity-check KV cache and model nodes
rdwctl debug kvcache --model gpt-3-x
```

Mira: Nice, thanks. One more — where do we log notes for incidents I shadow? I want to track learning items for my first-week checklist.

Lina: We use the oncall-journal sheet. Add a row with date, incident id (or N/A for sims), summary, and lessons-learned. Link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/ONCALL-JOURNAL

Mira: Perfect — I’ll sign up for Wednesday 9:00am PST shadow with Alex.

Alex: Confirmed, added to calendar and invited Sam as backup. Ping me if anything blocks before then.

OpsBot: Reminder: Sim training tomorrow 09:00 PST. Attendees: Mira, Alex, Sam.

Mira: Thanks everyone :raised_hands: — excited to get started and will update the journal after the shadow.
